Amber bulbs refract through wet glass while cooler city spill defines her face, the garment folds, and the rigid iron geometry. Preserve natural shoulder alignment, realistic hands gripping the bulb strand, real pores, fabric grain, rain specks, and a plausible unguarded instant.
